text:
Zoe Park: Heads-up team — just spotted a high-profile dev influencer (SamKTech) thread quoting our launch blog and calling out the latency numbers. It's starting to trend.

Henry Moss: Do we have an official response prepared or do we amplify the original blog?

Lara Kim: We should avoid reacting too fast. Proposal: (1) hold scheduled promotional posts for 30m, (2) prepare a short clarification thread if reporters ask, (3) offer quick dev Q&A for SamKTech.

PressOps Bot: Noted. I can draft an outreach list for journalists who might pick this up and prepare a one-paragraph clarifier for press. Recommend holding paid amplification until 30m after clarifier.

SocialBot: Pausing scheduled posts in queue for next 60m: primary tweet, FB post, and paid boosts paused. :pause_button:

Zoe Park: Thanks. Lara, can you draft the clarifier? Keep it factual, non-defensive. Something like: "Clarification: our published latency figures reflect median production loads on dedicated instances; see methodology: https://go.redwood/optimize-methods".

Lara Kim: Drafted. Two-sentence clarifier uploaded to doc. Also adding a short canned reply for SamKTech: `Thanks for the callout — happy to walk through the methodology or provide sample traces. DM us?`

Henry Moss: LegalBot 1 — any red flags if we DM and offer traces to an influencer? Sensitive data concerns?

LegalBot: We can offer aggregated traces and a sanitized sample. Do not share customer-identifying logs. Use approved language: "sanitized performance traces available on request under NDA or redacted public samples". Clearance given.

PressOps Bot: Outreach plan: if a reporter reaches out, use clarifier + offer a short interview with an engineer. I'll have templates ready. Also prepping an internal 1-pager for CS and Sales to handle inbound.

Zoe Park: Who's owning the journalist outreach list?

PressOps Bot: I'll owner it. Target list: Tech press + two trade outlets that monitor infra chatter. Scheduling a standby send 30m after clarifier if pickup is detected.

Lara Kim: Social update: once clarifier live, we'll post it as a pinned reply to original tweet and thread it to our account with methodology link. Delay paid boosts + monitor sentiment.

SocialBot: Ready to post clarifier on confirm. Will auto-unpause boosts 60m after go unless manual override.

Henry Moss: Also flag internal execs — if coverage picks up to >5 articles, we prep an executive statement. Zoe, can you be on standby to draft?

Zoe Park: Yep. I'll draft an exec blurb template now.

PressOps Bot: Action items recap: (1) Lara publish clarifier draft for Legal review (2) LegalBot approve final wording (3) SocialBot paused posts, ready to publish after Legal sign-off (4) PressOps prepare outreach & CS/Sales 1-pager.

LegalBot: Reviewed clarifier. Minor tweak: replace "median" with "typical" in opening sentence. Update made. Clearance: approved for public release.

Lara Kim: Updated and published clarifier: "Clarification: our published latency figures reflect typical production loads on dedicated instances; full methodology: https://go.redwood/optimize-methods". Posting as pinned reply now.

SocialBot: Clarifier posted and pinned. Paused posts remain on hold. Monitoring engagement and sentiment.

PressOps Bot: Internal 1-pager uploaded for CS/Sales: https://go.redwood/internal/press-pulse-1pager. Outreach templates ready.

Zoe Park: Great work team. Keep monitoring for press pickup. If any outlet requests embargoed materials, route to me and Henry for exec approval.

Henry Moss: :thumbsup: I'll watch the wire and reporter DMs. Thanks all.
